nasaRegionMap.method: Map registered to the LROC WAC South Pole Summer Mosaic by maximising image correlation (similarity transform); region boxes converted to polar-stereographic coordinates. See preprocess/register_nasa_regions.py.

regions.name: Peak near Cabeus B
regions.nasaListing: Candidate landing region in NASA's refined list of nine (Oct 28, 2024)

nasaRegion.source: Digitised from NASA's official map of the nine candidate regions (2024-10-28)

observationPoint.selectionRule: Observation point = of candidate points on a 1 km grid inside NASA's published region outline, with local slope at most 10° (LOLA, 240 m baseline), the one where the Sun's centre is above the LOLA terrain horizon for the largest fraction of 2027 (hourly). A representative point for this analysis, not a NASA landing site.

horizon.method: Maximum terrain elevation angle along great-circle rays (80 m–150 km), observer 2 m above surface, spherical Moon R=1737.4 km; DEM samples beyond the 80°S product edge ignored.

regional.note: 12×12 block-mean of LDEM_80S_80M; cells outside the 80°S product set to −20 km

notes: Region outline digitised from NASA's official map of the nine regions (2024-10-28): about 21 × 20 km, centred 83.64°S 68.77°W. NASA has not published coordinates; the outline is accurate to about 0.5 km.
